title: Classic Tuna Melt
description: Creamy tuna salad and melted cheese on crisp toast.
substitutions: Use plain Greek yogurt for part of the mayo.
Skip celery/pickle if you want it plain.

steps.text: Mix drained tuna with 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, optional celery or pickle, and black pepper.
Spread tuna over toast and top each with cheese.
Broil 1–2 minutes, watching closely, until cheese bubbles and melts.

title: Simple Egg Salad Sandwiches
description: Creamy, lightly seasoned egg salad for sandwiches or toast.
substitutions: Add diced pickle or celery if you like crunch.
Serve over lettuce instead of bread.

steps.text: Cover 6 eggs with water in a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, turn off heat, and let stand 10 minutes.
Cool eggs under cold water, peel, and chop.
Mix eggs with mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Spoon onto bread and make sandwiches.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Soft small-batch pancakes sweetened mostly with ripe banana.
substitutions: Blend oats for a smoother batter, or leave them whole.

steps.text: Mash 1 ripe banana in a bowl. Whisk in egg and 3/4 cup milk.
Stir in 1 cup oats, baking powder, and cinnamon. Let stand 3 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium. Cook small pancakes 2–3 minutes per side until set.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
description: Warm oatmeal with tender apple and cinnamon.

steps.text: Put oats, milk or water, diced apple, and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until creamy and the apple is tender.
Sweeten with brown sugar if desired and serve.
